desc: Ideation: identify move types (internal bipartite edges vs component merges) and candidate approaches/invariants.
Build brute-force game solver for small N and enumerate all bipartite graphs to compute winners and collect structural features.
Validate current code against the three public samples.
Run brute-force report for N=1..6/7 and produce feature tables for exact winners, especially even N and speculative mismatches.
Analyze tables to determine whether the even-N outcome depends on y, internal-pass parity, and component completeness; derive a candidate O(N+M) rule.
Validate candidate rule against all exact brute-force states for N<=7 and the samples.
Implement final O(N+M) solution replacing the speculative large-N fallback, with fast I/O and edge cases.
